title: Fairness-Aware Retrieval Optimization for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2605.15790v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds large language models (LLMs) in external knowledge, but the retrieved documents can systematically skew generated answers toward one group. This effect is difficult to analyze and control in top-k settings, where several documents at different context positions jointly shape the output. We present a three-stage framework for fairness-aware retrieval in top-k RAG. First, a probabilistic reranker sets the group composition of the retrieved context at each position, enabling controlled perturbation of retrieval bias without modifying the retriever. Second, we show that output bias is well approximated by a position-weighted linear function of position-wise retrieval bias, revealing model-specific positional sensitivities. translated_title: 面向检索增强生成的公平性感知检索优化
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过外部知识为大语言模型（LLM）提供依据，但检索到的文档可能会系统性地使生成的答案偏向某一群体。在top-k设置中，由于不同上下文位置上的多个文档共同塑造输出，这种效应难以分析和控制。我们提出了一个用于top-k RAG公平性感知检索的三阶段框架。首先，一个概率重排序器可以设定检索上下文中每个位置的群体构成，从而在不修改检索器的情况下实现对检索偏差的可控扰动。其次，我们证明输出偏差可以很好地用位置级检索偏差的位置加权线性函数来近似，揭示了模型特有的位置敏感性。第三，我们利用该模型将检索形式化为一个在相关性与预测输出偏差之间进行权衡的优化问题，并提出了FARO这一可扩展的解决方案（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出三阶段框架FARO，通过概率重排序器控制各位置的群体构成，并利用位置加权线性模型将检索形式化为相关性与输出偏差权衡的优化问题，实现top-k RAG中的公平性感知检索。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FARO, a three-stage framework that controls group composition at each retrieval position via probabilistic reranking and formulates retrieval as an optimization problem trading off relevance against predicted output bias, enabling fairness-aware retrieval in top-k RAG.
